<thought>We need a template that performs the retrosynthetic step of converting an alkyl halide back to an aliphatic alcohol (the reverse of the described substitution). The functional groups involved are “aliphatic hydroxyls” (broken in the forward direction) and “alkyl halide” (formed). From the initial search, the returned templates were complex and include protecting groups, suggesting they are not the simple OH→Cl transformation we need. To find a more appropriate simple template, we will search the template catalog again with the same functional group criteria but request more results (limit 20) to increase the chance of retrieving a straightforward aliphatic OH‑to‑halide template.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CCCl",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["alkyl halide"],
    "limit": 20
}</action_input>
